name: CAT vs DE Pair Comparison
description: Research study comparing Caterpillar (CAT) and Deere (DE) equities. Includes normalized price performance (rebased to 100), 60-day rolling Pearson correlation, CAT/DE price ratio, 252-day z-score of the ratio with ±2 reference lines, and a summary table with full-period returns, average correlation, current z-score, ratio mean, and ratio standard deviation.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CAT vs DE Pair Comparison
# Normalized performance, rolling correlation, price ratio, z-score analysis
# =============================================================================

# --- Universe Data (for cross-sectional normalized chart) ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Get first close for rebasing to 100
first_close = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(close)
norm_price = close / first_close * 100

# Timestamp for x-axis
ts = index()

# --- Reference Data (for pair-level calculations) ---
cat_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='CAT')()
de_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='DE')()
cat_close = cat_ref.c
de_close = de_ref.c

# --- Daily Returns (for correlation) ---
cat_ret = returns()(cat_close)
de_ret = returns()(de_close)

# --- Rolling 60-Day Pearson Correlation ---
corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=cat_ret, y=de_ret)

# --- Price Ratio: CAT / DE ---
ratio = cat_close / de_close

# --- Z-Score of Ratio (252-day rolling) ---
ratio_zscore = zscore(window=252)(ratio)

# --- Ratio Statistics ---
ratio_mean = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(ratio)
ratio_std = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(ratio)

# --- Full-Period Returns ---
cat_total_ret = (cat_close - (cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(cat_close))) / cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(cat_close)
de_total_ret = (de_close - (cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(de_close))) / cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(de_close)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# 1. Cross-Sectional Lines: Normalized Price Performance (rebased to 100)
cs_lines(
    title='Normalized Price Performance (Base = 100)',
    y_axis_label='Indexed Price',
    category='1. Performance',
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=norm_price)

# 2. Rolling 60-Day Correlation (per-asset xy_lines, same on both asset pages)
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Pearson Correlation (Returns-Based)',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    category='2. Correlation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CAT-DE Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=corr_60d)

# 3. CAT/DE Price Ratio Over Time
xy_lines(
    title='CAT / DE Price Ratio',
    y_axis_label='Ratio',
    category='3. Ratio Analysis',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CAT/DE Ratio', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=ratio)

# 4. Z-Score of CAT/DE Ratio (252-day window) with reference lines
xy_lines(
    title='CAT/DE Ratio Z-Score (252-Day Rolling)',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    category='3. Ratio Analysis',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Ratio Z-Score', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title='+2σ', color=Color.Error, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Mean', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='-2σ', color=Color.Success, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=ratio_zscore)

# 5. Summary Table: Key Pair Statistics
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Pair Statistics Summary',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['CAT Total Return', 'DE Total Return', 'Avg 60d Correlation', 'Current Ratio Z-Score', 'Ratio Mean / Std Dev'],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Summary',
    order=4
)(cat_total_ret, de_total_ret, corr_60d, ratio_zscore, ratio_mean)
